title: Introducing ChatGPT agent
summary: Introducing ChatGPT agent: it thinks and acts, using tools to complete tasks like research, bookings, and slideshows—all with your guidance.
body: Introducing ChatGPT agent: it thinks and acts, using tools to complete tasks like research, bookings, and slideshows—all with your guidance.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了ChatGPT Agent，该系统能够通过自主思考和调用外部工具来完成研究、日程预订及文档制作等复杂任务，旨在提升用户交互的自动化水平。原始信息显示：Introducing ChatGPT agent: it thinks and acts, using tools to complete tasks like research, bookings, and slideshows—all with your guidance.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing ChatGPT agent”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI推出了具备自主思考与工具调用能力的ChatGPT Agent，标志着其产品向主动式智能体演进。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
